Hi Luke & Priya —

Thanks again for the great discovery earlier today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can lock in the sizing details and a technical demo for your infra/ML team:

- Key constraints you mentioned: 30–50 concurrent requests at peak, median request length ~120 tokens, a handful of heavy batched re-ranks at ~600 tokens.
- Latency target: p95 under 250ms for single-request paths; relaxed for batch re-ranks.
- Data residency/security: US-only for now, SOC2 required.

Next steps we recommend:
1) Dedicated capacity sizing call (30–45m) with Marcus (solutions eng) to work through throughput profiles, typical sequences, and warm-cache assumptions.
2) Technical deep dive/demo (45–60m) for your infra & ML engineering teams to see a live workload run and to validate kernel/quantization tradeoffs.

Proposed time slots (PT):
- Tue May 5, 10:00–10:45 or 11:30–12:15
- Wed May 6, 14:00–14:45

If none of those work, share a couple of windows (we can be flexible). I attached a short intro deck and a small CSV template you can fill with sample request profiles — that will make the Marcus call much faster.

I’ll also open a quick HubSpot record and put the proposed calendar invite on hold once you confirm a slot.

Cheers,
Rachel
